notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Here is the feedback I received from one of the testers:
"After testing it for a while, I think it’s playable on the Deck, using the trackpad as a mouse and the trigger as a click."
Let me know if you had a different experience, or if you have any suggestions for making it work better.
